g.text: alive with the robot off. U3 runs from the Waveshare 3V3 (header).

g.desc: alive with the robot off. U3 runs from the Waveshare 3V3 (header).

g.text: at 9 mm on axis gives ~20 mT (2x margin); release <= ~20 mm.

g.desc: at 9 mm on axis gives ~20 mT (2x margin); release <= ~20 mm.

g.text: U2 runs from VBAT all the time (2.5 uA Iq): U1 + U4 keep the interlock

g.desc: U2 runs from VBAT all the time (2.5 uA Iq): U1 + U4 keep the interlock

g.text: U1 DRV5032AJ: BOP 9.5 mT max, BRP 3 mT min. N52 3/8 x 1/16 in disc

g.desc: U1 DRV5032AJ: BOP 9.5 mT max, BRP 3 mT min. N52 3/8 x 1/16 in disc

g.text: I2C: INA219 CHARGE MONITOR, TCA9534 GPIO, HEADER

g.desc: I2C: INA219 CHARGE MONITOR, TCA9534 GPIO, HEADER

g.text: Main path: J1 -> F1 10 A -> VBAT -> J3 to the Pololu Big Pushbutton Power Switch -> back on J4 (VSW) -> J5 to the Waveshare XH2.54 port.

g.desc: Main path: J1 -> F1 10 A -> VBAT -> J3 to the Pololu Big Pushbutton Power Switch -> back on J4 (VSW) -> J5 to the Waveshare XH2.54 port.

g.text: Copper: 2 oz both sides; VBAT / VSW / BAT_IN are top pours >= 6 mm wide, GND is the bottom pour (IPC-2221 ext.: 3.5 mm at 2 oz for 10 A, 10 C rise).

g.desc: Copper: 2 oz both sides; VBAT / VSW / BAT_IN are top pours >= 6 mm wide, GND is the bottom pour (IPC-2221 ext.: 3.5 mm at 2 oz for 10 A, 10 C rise).

g.text: Charging joins VBAT before the switch, so it works with the robot switched off.

g.desc: Charging joins VBAT before the switch, so it works with the robot switched off.

g.text: R11/R12 are DNP: fit only if the Waveshare bus has no pull-ups (pull up to the Waveshare 3V3,

g.desc: R11/R12 are DNP: fit only if the Waveshare bus has no pull-ups (pull up to the Waveshare 3V3,

g.text: never to +3V3_AON, so the bus does not back-power the ESP32 when the robot is off).

g.desc: never to +3V3_AON, so the bus does not back-power the ESP32 when the robot is off).

g.text: Waveshare onboard (not ours): INA219 ~0x42 (unconfirmed), QMI8658C 0x6A/0x6B, AK09918C 0x0C.

g.desc: Waveshare onboard (not ours): INA219 ~0x42 (unconfirmed), QMI8658C 0x6A/0x6B, AK09918C 0x0C.

g.text: J6 pin order is 3V3/GND/SDA/SCL: confirm against the Waveshare circuit diagram.

g.desc: J6 pin order is 3V3/GND/SDA/SCL: confirm against the Waveshare circuit diagram.
